Once a year. One night. A look at what comes after graduation.
Join Sheridan Marketing Society for The Annual Marketing Mixer … a night to hear what life in marketing actually looks like beyond the classroom.
We’ll be talking about starting your marketing career, networking, work-life balance, creating your own opportunities, and everything in between.
Marketing Career Reality Check Hear from marketing professionals and alumni about their experiences, lessons, and what they wish they knew when they were starting out.
Connect & Network Meet alumni, industry professionals, and fellow marketing students from different areas of the field.
☕ Refreshments provided
📅 October 14, 2026, 6:00-8:00 PM, Room A145, HMC Campus 📍 Sheridan College
Whether you’re just starting your marketing degree or already thinking about what comes next, this is a night to meet people, ask questions, and get a real look at what’s ahead.
The conversation starts here.

lines: 1430 Trafalgar Rd, Oakville, ON L6H 2L1, Oakville, ON
address.map_url: http://maps.google.com?q=1430 Trafalgar Rd, Oakville, ON L6H 2L1, Oakville, ON

events.description:
Hello Pixels! We’re back again with a Halloween-themed design challenge. From October 1st to October 31st @ 11:59pm, you have the opportunity to create your own design based off of our challenge prompts:
UX/UI + Web Design - Create a movie teaser/promotional website for your favourite Halloween movie, OR create an online store website that exists inside the movie universe
Visual Design - Re-create the movie poster for your favourite Halloween movie OR design a custom ticket/pass for a special screening event for the movie
Motion Design - Design a 5-second GIF/short animation of your favourite character, OR animate a custom opening title sequence, OR a UI micro-animation inspired by the movie (ex. a button that turns into a spinning pumpkin)
3D Design - Create a 3D model of an iconic movie prop (ex. the Coraline button key), OR design a mini 3D spooky room/space that’s inspired by a scene in the movie (ex. the Addams family home, or the shining hallway)
This will be judged based on creativity & uniqueness, theme relevance, and execution.
By participating, you will have the chance to win some amazing prizes like headphones, Halloween treat boxes, and/or gift cards up to $50!
We will have 1st, 2nd and 3rd place prizes for winners. Winners will be announced by November 13th at the latest, so check your e-mails to see if we have contacted you.
No experience needed! Sketches, low-fi prototypes, and beginner attempts are all welcome ;) This event is open to ALL. Prize Pickup will be handled at the Trafalgar Campus , if accommodations are needed, this can be discussed once we contact you. Upload your submission to this Google Form link: https://forms.gle/R2Ek9htjmaGkUxHK7

events.description:
The Sheridan Datathon is a 24-hour data hackathon organized by GDG on Campus Sheridan. On November 7–8, 2026, 250+ students from across the GTA will come together at Sheridan's HMC Campus to work with real-world datasets provided by industry sponsors: turning them into insights, models, and data-driven stories.
It's basically a hackathon, but the challenge is centered around data instead of just building something. Teams will get actual datasets and work to find the most interesting insight or story hidden inside. They're being judged more on what they discovered than what they built. So the final submission could be a research draft, a model, a dashboard, a working prototype, or a new solution to a problem. Not just a web app.
Participants will:
Work in teams of 4 across multiple tracks (AI/ML, Data Visualization, Social Impact, and a Beginner-friendly track)
Access datasets and problem statements provided by industry sponsors
Attend workshops and receive mentorship from data professionals
Present final projects to a panel of industry judges
Compete for prizes, recruiter access, and recognition across the GTA
Whether it's their first hackathon or their tenth, participants will walk away with a portfolio-worthy project grounded in real data, direct exposure to recruiters actively hiring in this space, and a stronger connection to the emerging data community across the GTA.
